name: PTZ camera FOV-move calibrator with ONVIF proxy

mentions.name: PTZ camera FOV-move calibrator with ONVIF proxy
mentions.description: A tool that characterises PTZ cameras with computer-vision tools and calibrates movement curves, producing a data file that an ONVIF proxy uses to emulate the more advanced move commands the cameras lack.
mentions.problem: Many PTZ cameras don't support FOV move, which NVRs need for ML object detection and tracking, and only offer a clunky continuous move and stop.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been beating my head against a camera tool for a while now, finally making headway. Many ptz cameras dont support fov move, which nvrs need for ml object detection and tracking. They just have a super clunky continuous move and stop. So my tool characterises the camera with cv tools and calibrates movement curves to produce a data file that can be used by my onvif proxy to emulate the more advanced move commands.
mentions.author: jhogendorn
